notes: Fixed false login prompts across the runner and desktop: unrelated IDs or text containing 401, 403, auth, or login no longer count as authentication failures.
Permission-only 403 responses and temporary token-renewal outages, timeouts, and rate limits no longer force browser login.
Genuine credential rejection still attempts silent renewal; revoked or missing refresh credentials retain gated browser authentication.
Numeric beta 3.3.1 is available through the existing in-app updater. The original five-minute/two-minute browser cooldown remains in place.
Reports only when failed authorization forces a browser popup; routine calls and throttling stay quiet.
Debug tabs: PBP Authorization first and selected by default, plus Throttling.
Ten seconds between failed token renewal attempts, including between batches.
New authorization windows limited to five minutes normally or two minutes in Mission Mode.
Use Debug > PBP Authorization > Open log folder to collect logs for manual sending.
